title: Two-Stage ML Pipeline: Intrusion Detection & CVSS Severity
summary: Detects network intrusions on the KDD99 dataset, then predicts CVSS severity from CVE data. It simulates a SOC-style workflow: detect a threat, then prioritize it.
details: Two-stage pipeline: intrusion detection on KDD99, then CVSS severity prediction on CVE data.
Random Forest and XGBoost ensembles for accuracy and robustness.
SMOTE and One-vs-Rest classification to handle class imbalance and improve minority-class recall.
Model evaluation and hyperparameter tuning; artifacts prepared for potential deployment.

title: Symbio-NLM: AI-Powered DNA Insight & Summary Platform
summary: A genomics web app that analyzes DNA sequences and explains them in plain language. The backend does the sequence analysis; Gemini writes the summaries and powers a chat assistant.
details: Backend processing for GC-content analysis, ORF detection, nucleotide distribution and FASTA validation.
Gemini AI APIs for sequence-specific natural-language summaries and chatbot-based genomics help.
Animated AI assistant chatbot with contextual interactions, built with GSAP.
REST API with JWT and bcrypt authentication.

title: Portfolio + AI Digital Twin
summary: This site. A chat assistant answers questions about my work using only the content on this page, links each answer to the section it came from, and says so when it doesn't know.
details: The whole portfolio is built into one context pack at deploy time, with a token budget and a phone-number check that fail the build.
Answers stream over Server-Sent Events; the model cites block IDs, which the server turns into source links.
Guardrails: input rules for off-topic and prompt-injection questions, an output check that stops phone numbers and prompt leaks mid-stream, and Gemini safety filters.
Rate limiting with hashed IPs, a daily cap, and anonymous question logs that expire after 90 days.
A 70-case eval set (facts, multi-hop, unknowns, out-of-scope, prompt injection, PII) runs against every deployment.
